pages.text: Feed a $(l)Training Treat$() to a tamed wolf to turn it into a $(l)Doggy Talents$() dog. These dogs level up and learn $(l)talents$(): pack mule, guard dog, rescue dog, fisher dog, and more.$(br2)Your starter kit has 3 treats. Olly works on both regular wolves and Doggy Talents dogs, so naming him still works after training.

pages.title: Whistle
pages.text: Calls, sits, and sends your dogs. While holding it, the number keys pick a whistle mode.

pages.title: Dog Bed
pages.text: Give your dog a home base. Dogs rest at their bed, and it's how you keep track of where everyone lives.
